title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling businesses to optimise checkout, reduce RTO, power payments, drive retention, and unlock post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building technology and financial infrastructure that powers the next generation of digital commerce.


Why This Role Matters

As a Customer Success Manager, you will partner with mid-market and growth-stage D2C brands to help them maximise the value of GoKwik’s solutions. You will own customer relationships end-to-end, driving onboarding, product adoption, retention, and account growth while using data-driven insights to improve checkout conversion and customer experience.
This role combines account management, business advisory, analytics, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with brand founders, eCommerce leaders, and growth teams to identify opportunities, solve business challenges, and deliver measurable outcomes.


What You’ll Own

  • Onboarding & Adoption: Own the onboarding and go-live journey for new brands. Drive adoption of KwikCheckout features and ensure merchants leverage the platform effectively.
  • Retention & Growth: Own account health and retention across your portfolio. Identify opportunities for upsell and cross-sell across GoKwik’s product suite to drive account growth.
  • Account Management: Manage a portfolio of mid-market and growth-stage D2C accounts, develop success plans, conduct regular business reviews, track account health, and proactively address churn risks.
  • Performance & Insights: Track checkout funnel metrics, conversion rates, payment success rates, COD/prepaid mix, and RTO trends. Translate data into actionable recommendations that improve business performance.
  • Brand Advisory: Partner with brand founders, eCommerce heads, and growth teams to identify opportunities to improve conversion, payment performance, and customer experience.
  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the trusted point of contact for assigned brands, building strong relationships across business, marketing, eCommerce, and operations teams.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to resolve customer challenges, communicate feedback, and influence product improvements.
  • Process Excellence: Follow and improve customer success playbooks, escalation processes, and reporting mechanisms to strengthen execution and scale customer success efficiently.


Who You Are

  • 3–6 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Key Account Management, preferably working with D2C brands, eCommerce businesses, marketplaces, or D2C enablement SaaS platforms.
  • Strong understanding of the D2C business, including acquisition, conversion, average order value (AOV), repeat purchases, COD, and RTO dynamics.
  • Experience managing multiple customer accounts with measurable outcomes across retention, product adoption, or revenue growth.
  • Familiarity with checkout platforms, payment gateways, Shopify or other eCommerce technologies, or conversion optimisation is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with dashboards, Excel, or Google Sheets to identify trends and develop actionable recommendations. SQL or BI tool experience is an added advantage.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage founders and senior business leaders.
  • A proactive, customer-first problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.
  • Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to independently drive customer outcomes and collaborate effectively across teams.


Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with some of the fastest-growing D2C and eCommerce brands and directly influence their business growth. You’ll combine customer relationships, data-driven problem-solving, and product expertise to improve conversion, retention, and customer experience. With a high-ownership culture, exposure to a rapidly evolving commerce ecosystem, and opportunities to collaborate with cross-functional teams, you’ll be able to build meaningful customer partnerships and create measurable business impact.

title: Senior Associate - Business Operations
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling businesses to optimise checkout, reduce RTO, power payments, drive retention, and unlock post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building technology and financial infrastructure that powers the next generation of digital commerce.


Why This Role Matters

As a Senior Associate – Business Operations, you will play a critical role in ensuring a seamless shipping experience for GoKwik’s merchants. You will be responsible for handling shipment-level queries, resolving operational issues, managing support tickets, and coordinating with internal Operations and Account Management teams to ensure timely resolution.
The role requires strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment where quick and accurate problem-solving directly impacts merchant experience.


What You’ll Own

  • Shipment Query Management: Respond to daily shipment-level queries from merchants across email, ticketing systems, WhatsApp, and calls.
  • Shipment Investigation: Investigate order and shipment status using KwikShip and courier dashboards and provide merchants with clear, accurate, and timely updates.
  • Issue Resolution: Own common shipment-related issues end-to-end, including pickup delays, stuck or misrouted shipments, NDR follow-ups, delivery disputes, lost or damaged parcels, and RTO queries.
  • Internal Coordination: Work closely with Operations and relevant internal teams to investigate and resolve merchant issues within defined timelines.
  • Account Manager Collaboration: Keep Account Managers informed about high-impact, recurring, or account-level issues that may affect merchant relationships.
  • Escalation Management: Identify and escalate issues that could impact SLAs, merchant experience, or business continuity, ensuring all relevant context is provided.
  • Ticket & SLA Management: Own the ticket queue for assigned merchants and ensure first response and resolution are delivered within agreed TATs.
  • Prioritisation: Prioritise issues based on urgency and business impact, particularly during sale events, peak periods, and high-volume business days.
  • Process Improvement: Identify recurring issues and operational bottlenecks and work with relevant teams to improve resolution processes and merchant experience.


Who You Are

  • 2–4 years of experience in Business Operations, Customer Success, Customer Support, Operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience handling customer or merchant queries in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and drive them to closure.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently manage multiple issues and priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and calmly during escalations.
  • Comfortable working with dashboards, ticketing systems, and operational data.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy while handling high query volumes.
  • Experience in eCommerce, D2C, logistics, shipping, SaaS, or high-growth startups is a strong plus.


Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you’ll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, operations, and eCommerce while directly influencing the experience of thousands of merchants. You’ll solve real-time business and operational challenges, work closely with cross-functional teams, and gain deep exposure to the D2C commerce and logistics ecosystem. With a high-ownership culture and a fast-paced environment, this role offers the opportunity to build strong operational expertise while creating measurable impact at scale.

title: Associate Customer Success Manager
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling businesses to optimise checkout, reduce RTO, power payments, drive retention, and unlock post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building technology and financial infrastructure that powers the next generation of digital commerce.
KwikEngage is GoKwik’s WhatsApp Commerce Suite, helping D2C brands drive customer engagement, improve retention, increase conversions, and build stronger customer relationships through WhatsApp.


Why This Role Matters

As an Associate Customer Success Manager for KwikEngage, you will play a key role in helping D2C brands adopt the platform, drive engagement, and achieve measurable business outcomes. You will work closely with customers to understand their goals, support onboarding and adoption, identify growth opportunities, and build strong, long-term relationships.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with customers, using data to solve problems, and operating in a fast-paced environment where they can take ownership and grow quickly.


What You’ll Own

  • Customer Success & Adoption: Support customer onboarding, drive product adoption, and ensure brands are able to effectively leverage KwikEngage.
  • Growth & Retention: Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, retention, upsell, and cross-sell through data-driven interventions.
  • Account Management: Manage a portfolio of D2C accounts, track customer success milestones, proactively address challenges, and support churn prevention.
  • Business Growth: Work with customers to identify opportunities across acquisition, engagement, retention, and customer lifecycle.
  • Performance & Insights: Analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour, and WhatsApp journeys to identify insights and recommend improvements.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with marketing teams, founders, and other key stakeholders while acting as a trusted point of contact.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and internal teams to resolve customer challenges and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Process Excellence: Contribute to customer success processes, documentation, playbooks, and best practices to improve efficiency and customer experience at scale.


Who You Are

  • 1–3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Servicing, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably in SaaS, D2C, martech, or marketing automation.
  • Experience managing customer accounts and driving adoption, engagement, retention, or revenue outcomes.
  • Exposure to WhatsApp Business APIs, retention marketing, CRM platforms, or automation workflows is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and make recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A customer-first approach with a willingness to learn, experiment, and take initiative.


Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you’ll have the opportunity to work on a fast-growing WhatsApp Commerce platform and partner with leading D2C brands. You’ll get high ownership and exposure to customer growth, retention, and engagement while working closely with experienced teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Business. With a high-performance culture, rapid learning opportunities, and the chance to help shape a growing WhatsApp Commerce ecosystem, this role offers a strong platform to build and accelerate your career in Customer Success.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling businesses to optimise checkout, reduce RTO, power payments, drive retention, and unlock post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building technology and financial infrastructure that powers the next generation of digital commerce.
KwikEngage is GoKwik’s WhatsApp Commerce Suite, helping D2C brands drive customer engagement, improve retention, increase conversions, and build stronger customer relationships through WhatsApp.


Why This Role Matters

As a Customer Success Manager for KwikEngage, you will be responsible for helping high-impact D2C brands unlock the full value of the platform. You will own customer relationships end-to-end — from onboarding and adoption to retention, growth, and expansion.
This role combines customer success, account management, data-driven problem solving, and business strategy. You will work closely with founders, CXOs, and marketing leaders to identify opportunities, drive measurable business outcomes, and build long-term partnerships.


What You’ll Own

  • Customer Success & Adoption: Lead account onboarding, drive product adoption, and ensure customers consistently realise value from KwikEngage.
  • Growth & Retention: Identify and execute opportunities to improve customer retention, engagement, upsell, and cross-sell.
  • Account Management: Own a portfolio of high-value D2C accounts, track success milestones, proactively address risks, and minimise churn.
  • Business Strategy: Partner with customers to identify growth opportunities across acquisition, engagement, retention, and customer lifecycle.
  • Performance & Insights: Analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour, and WhatsApp journeys to identify actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with founders, CXOs, marketing heads, and other key stakeholders, becoming their trusted point of contact.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other internal teams to solve customer challenges and influence product improvements.
  • Process Excellence: Build and improve customer success processes, documentation, playbooks, and best practices to enhance customer experience at scale.


Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role, preferably in SaaS, D2C, martech, or marketing automation.
  • Experience managing mid-market to enterprise accounts with demonstrated impact on customer growth, retention, or revenue.
  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle, retention marketing, CRM, or marketing automation.
  • Hands-on experience with WhatsApp Business APIs, WhatsApp marketing, CRM platforms, or automation workflows is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work with senior business leaders.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently manage multiple accounts and drive outcomes.


Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you’ll have the opportunity to work on a fast-growing WhatsApp Commerce platform and partner with some of India’s leading D2C brands. You’ll have high ownership and autonomy, work closely with founders and senior business leaders, and play a key role in shaping how brands leverage WhatsApp to drive engagement, retention, and growth. With a high-performance culture and exposure to a rapidly evolving commerce ecosystem, this role offers significant opportunities to learn, build, and grow.

title: Assistant Manager - Partnerships
description:
About GoKwik
GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands from checkout optimisation and reducing return-to-origin (RTO), to payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables over 12,000 merchants worldwide, processes around $2 billion in GMV, and is strengthening its AI-powered infrastructure. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments and bolstered by a $13 million growth round in June 2025 (total funding: $68 million), GoKwik is scaling aggressively across India and the UK.

Why This Role Matters
Partnerships fuel GoKwik’s growth engine. Every new integration, every ecosystem collaboration, and every agency tie-up directly impacts our ability to scale merchants faster. As a Assistant Manager - Partnerships, you’ll be at the center of building, nurturing, and scaling our partner ecosystem—whether it’s Shopify agencies, tech enablers, or solution providers. This role isn’t just about relationships, it’s about creating a multiplier effect: every partner you bring in opens doors to dozens of new merchants and opportunities.

What You’ll Own
  • Partner engagement at scale – identify, onboard, and manage agencies, SaaS enablers, and ecosystem players across ecommerce and Shopify
  • Relationship building – cultivate strong day-to-day connections with founders, CXOs, and account managers to unlock joint growth
  • Joint value creation – co-build GTM strategies, execute co-marketing initiatives, and establish lead-sharing mechanisms
  • Partner enablement – ensure partners are trained on GoKwik’s value propositions and equipped with updated product knowledge
  • Performance tracking – monitor partner pipelines, leads generated, and revenue contribution while driving accountability
  • Ecosystem intelligence – stay plugged into the Indian D2C/Shopify ecosystem, mapping agencies and SaaS tools to uncover gaps and opportunities
  • Cross-functional collaboration – align with sales, marketing, and product to ensure partner-led motions translate into revenue

Who You Are
  • 3-5 years of experience in partnerships, business development, or client-facing roles within ecommerce, Shopify, SaaS, or the D2C ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of Shopify agencies, ecommerce enablers, and the Indian D2C landscape
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders
  • Analytical mindset—comfortable tracking performance metrics and identifying growth levers
  • Curious, collaborative, and thrives in fast-paced, high-ownership environments
  • (Bonus) Background in a Shopify agency or ecommerce SaaS tool is a plus

Why GoKwik
At GoKwik, we aren’t just building checkout and conversion tools—we’re building the growth fabric for ecommerce in India and beyond. Partnerships are at the core of this mission, helping us plug into the right ecosystems and accelerate adoption across thousands of brands. If you’re excited about shaping the future of ecommerce enablement and want to work at the intersection of strategy, ecosystem building, and growth—this role is for you.
